newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.50 to the dollar on Friday amid a rise in demand for the U.S. currency and dealers said the rupee was likely to open stable on Saturday.
They said there was a lot of dollar demand, but a liquidity crunch had helped the rupee hold its own against the U.S. unit.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on June 28, was 40.4600/40.6623 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed steady at 2.65 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
